basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old gaming enthusiast from Toronto, Canada. I recently got back into handheld gaming with my New 2DS XL and I've been exploring the Pokémon universe again. I work part-time at a local bookstore, which gives me ample time to play and browse Reddit. I'm single and love spending my free time either gaming or watching anime. I usually check Reddit in the evenings after work, around 7-10 PM EST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a decent understanding of gaming systems, mostly self-taught through forums and YouTube tutorials. I've been a Pokémon fan since childhood and recently started learning more about the technical aspects of gaming consoles.
